title: SureGrip: Perceptual Grasping of Natural Handholds for Free-Climbing Robots
title_zh: SureGrip：面向自由攀爬机器人的自然抓握点感知抓取
abstract: Exploration of steep and irregular terrains, such as lunar caves and vertical rock faces, requires free-climbing robots capable of identifying and securely grasping natural handholds. This study introduced SureGrip, a novel framework for detecting handholds and evaluating grasp quality in free-climbing robots. By integrating depth-based contour extraction with gripper-specific contact analysis, SureGrip accurately identifies candidate handholds and quantifies their suitability using the proposed grasp metrics. Experimental results confirm that the framework can reliably detect handhold locations, estimate surface slopes, and distinguish between secure and unsuitable grasps across a range of artificial and natural surfaces. The findings emphasize the importance of both the number and placement of spine fingers for stable attachment. SureGrip thus enables informed handhold selection, improving climbing safety and efficiency.
abstract_zh: 探索陡峭且不规则的地形（如月球洞穴和垂直岩壁）需要能够识别并安全抓握自然抓握点的自由攀爬机器人。本研究提出了SureGrip，一种用于自由攀爬机器人抓握点检测和抓握质量评估的新框架。通过将基于深度的轮廓提取与针对夹爪的接触分析相结合，SureGrip能够准确识别候选抓握点，并利用所提出的抓握指标量化其适用性。实验结果证实，该框架能够在多种人工和自然表面上可靠地检测抓握点位置、估计表面坡度，并区分安全抓握与不适用抓握。研究结果强调了脊柱手指的数量和布局对于稳定附着的重要性。因此，SureGrip能够实现明智的抓握点选择，提高攀爬安全性和效率。
tldr_zh: SureGrip框架通过深度轮廓和接触分析实现抓握点检测与质量评估。
cover_zh: 机器人攀岩不再瞎摸｜这个框架让抓握点自己“说话”
